nodes.text: #HMPV Virus in Gujarat: 9-Month-Old Child Tests Positive for #HumanMetapneumovirus in Ahmedabad; Cases Rise to 4 in State. #Gujarat has reported its fourth #HMPV case, with a nine-month-old child contracting the infection in #Ahmedabad, officials said Saturday.
